text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. I took care to
rest
properly and recuperate, just like
you said.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
There's a fitting maxim that says,
"Resting is a
part of training." I feel like
an entirely new person after resting up.
I'm brimming with energy!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Today's training is certain to yield
valuable
results. Until then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Yaeno Muteki got plenty of
rest!
